The grade -2 plane of V(3/2) x V(3/2) is an eigenspace of the potential with the lane's value 7/(2 l^2), and the conjugate form matches it at the opposite weights; the transition matrices give the quaternion group of order 8, irreducible, for both charges; the arithmetic of one section (h0 = 1) checks; on main's E8 the non-zero products of the vector and down components are exactly the lane's two, in both modules; and the residue matrix on the two currents is rank two under any unitary change.
